dataGaps.R7: Sections with numbers that have no real source (the 500 pool total, the 300 weekend ceiling, the 1000 per-day ceiling, workshop 10 places, symposium/WOSA 80) are shown ONLY if the number is a real stored value (ticketType.capacity/releasedQuantity or Firestore sold counts). The pool total in poolText is a CMS/Firestore-derived value; where it is not available the banner and the pool wording are not rendered at all.

sectionLedes.note: design-cb ruling: the one-line scope under each h2 is part of v13 (Karla 16/1.55, ink-700, <=60ch, 8px under the h2, [data-section-lede]). Mock wording verbatim; facts only from the sources below; a lede whose fact cannot be sourced is omitted (no empty node, no spacer).

thursday.sources: {d} {Month}: nationalShow.showDate (Sanity singleton, R24; must be a Thursday); "Two": the two Thursday products present (VIP and Sunset cards)
thursday.omitWhen: showDate missing or not a Thursday, or either Thursday card absent

passes.sources: start = showDate + 1 day, end = nationalShow.showEndDate (Sanity, R24); weekday and day computed from the calendar dates
passes.omitWhen: either date missing, the range is not within one month and year, or start is after end

programme.omitWhen: any of the three programme cards absent
